name: What are the benefits of using a general contractor for project management versus managing it myself?

mainEntity.name: What are the benefits of using a general contractor for project management versus managing it myself?

acceptedAnswer.text: Using a general contractor like City Dweller, LLC for project management offers significant benefits over self-management. A general contractor has established relationships with trusted subcontractors, expertise in scheduling and budget management, and a deep understanding of local building codes and permitting requirements in the Bay Area. We can secure better pricing on materials and labor, ensure higher quality work, and handle unexpected issues efficiently, saving you time, stress, and potential costly mistakes.
acceptedAnswer.description: A general contractor brings expertise, established relationships, and local code knowledge, saving you time, stress, and potential costs compared to self-managing a project.
